rows.grounds: compound siddha-mantra; subject denoting one whose mantra is perfected
locative indicating the sphere of manifestation
compound bala-adhika; predicate describing the resulting condition

items.question: What immediate condition and strength does an accomplished-mantra practitioner attain on earth?
premises: A practitioner possesses an accomplished mantra.
The resulting state arises at that very time.
The practitioner becomes superior in strength on earth.
items.inference: Mantra accomplishment immediately confers superior strength upon the practitioner in the earthly realm.
items.plain_english: But one whose mantra is accomplished immediately becomes superior in strength on earth.
